decisions.obstacle: Trace acetic acid in the washed ester: the product column must handle two liquid phases on its stages with the acid present.
decisions.mechanism: Distil the ternary azeotrope overhead and take ethyl acetate as the bottoms, with vapour-liquid-liquid equilibrium on the stages (UNIQUAC, phases VLL, as in the run requests).
decisions.operation: Product column 11 run alone on the paper's stream 13 with 0.01 mass % acetic acid, bottoms flow specified at 140, 141 and 141.5 kmol/h.
decisions.expected_change: Ethyl acetate as the bottoms, meeting the paper's product purity.
limits: CHEPTA 0.6.2 returns NO_CONVERGENCE at all three flows; this says nothing about the paper's own simulator.
